exposure: preoperative autologous blood donation (PABD) storage volume
cohort: 269 patients with placenta previas or low-lying placentas who provided preoperative autologous blood donations (PABDs) at a hospital between 2008 and 2013.
finding: Storing 600 mL of preoperative autologous blood (PABD) was found to be an appropriate volume for surgery for placenta previas and low-lying placentas to effectively avoid allogeneic transfusion.
